At the top of the stairs, centered in the frame against a pale sky, is a large, textured, egg-shaped or rock-like sculpture.

It appears slightly 'fuzzy' or like a cloud/rock hybrid, which is a common generative artifact where the model fails to resolve fine surface details of complex objects.

The connection between the right-hand red rail and the vertical post near the top landing appears slightly soft and ill-defined, lacking the sharp mechanical joint expected in real-world construction.
The horizontal lines of the stair treads show slight waviness and inconsistency in thickness, suggesting minor geometric instability in the generation of the rigid concrete structure.
